title: Infinite money -
script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet(
    "https://sirius.menu/rayfield"
))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Money Gui",
    LoadingTitle = "Money Gui",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Money",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false,
        FolderName = nil,
        FileName = "MoneyGui",
    },
    KeySystem = false,
})

--==================================================
-- Money Tab
--==================================================

local MoneyTab = Window:CreateTab("Money", nil)
MoneyTab:CreateSection("Get Money")

local amount = 500000

MoneyTab:CreateInput({
    Name = "Money Amount",
    PlaceholderText = "Enter amount",
    RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,

    Callback = function(text)
        local value = tonumber(text)

        if value
            and value > 0
            and value == math.floor(value) then
            amount = value
        end
    end,
})

MoneyTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Get Money",

    Callback = function()
        local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Events")
        local remote = events and events:FindFirstChild("SellOreEvent")

        if not remote then
            Rayfield:Notify({
                Title = "Money Gui",
                Content = "SellOreEvent was not found, it was most likely patched or ur executor is ass.",
                Duration = 1,
            })
            return
        end

        remote:FireServer(amount)

        Rayfield:Notify({
            Title = "Money Gui",
            Content = "Money request sent.",
            Duration = 1,
        })
    end,
})

Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "Money Gui",
    Content = "Money interface loaded.",
    Duration = 1,
})
